# Sonu Thomas

> AI Software Engineer specializing in agentic systems, production LLM applications, enterprise backend architectures, and modern web platforms.

Sonu Thomas is an AI Software Engineer at HCLTech and a Data Science & Artificial Intelligence scholar at IIT Guwahati (BSc Hons, 2024–2028). With hands-on experience in software development and applied engineering, Sonu designs and evaluates scalable, reliable, and observable AI-powered systems.

## Flagship Systems Architecture
- **Agentic Co-Worker Platform**: Deploying a fleet of 100+ Core Digital Workers across 15 IT specializations—coordinated by an intelligent Central Brain—to automate ITSM, DevOps, SRE, security, and operational intelligence workflows in enterprise production environments. Reduces MTTR by 70% with LangGraph state machines, Gemini LLM, MCP protocol, ChromaDB, and real-time WebSockets.
- **Change Co-Worker**: Enterprise-grade multi-agent change intelligence platform with 5 specialized AI agents powered by Gemini 2.5 Flash and RAG. Automates IT change creation, risk scoring, conflict detection, and CAB compliance reports with live ServiceNow ITSM sync and zero hallucinations.
- **RCA-Agent**: AI-powered Root Cause Analysis system for production incidents. Combines multi-step reasoning, ChromaDB vector retrieval across operational datasets (logs, runbooks, incidents, changes), Gemini LLM embeddings, and an asynchronous Flask API with an interactive web diagnostics UI.
- **TicketWave**: Production-grade travel and event ticket booking modular monolith engineered with Spring Boot 3, React 18, and PostgreSQL. Features a three-layer double-booking defense (Redis locks, Redis TTL holds, PostgreSQL unique constraints), dynamic surge pricing, and sub-100ms booking latency. GitHub: https://github.com/Sonu-Thomas-001/TicketWave
- **SmartDesk AI**: Intelligent multi-agent IT incident management platform powered by Gemini 2.0 Flash and ChromaDB vector retrieval. Automates ServiceNow incident detection, classification, assignment across 8 specialist teams, and resolution guide generation with a self-improving feedback loop. GitHub: https://github.com/Sonu-Thomas-001/SmartDesk-Ai
- **QubiMind**: Enterprise-grade multi-agent AI operating system developed by QubiQode that enables organizations to deploy, manage, and orchestrate fleets of specialized AI agents. Built with LangGraph state machines, Next.js 15, FastAPI, Enterprise RAG, external tool calling, human-in-the-loop manager approval nodes, and SOC2 bank-grade security with 5-tier RBAC. GitHub: https://github.com/Sonu-Thomas-001/QubiMind
- **Multi-Agent Enterprise AI Assistant**: Flagship enterprise AI platform orchestrating 7 specialized micro-agents in concurrent, stateful LangGraph channels. Features a dual-retriever hybrid RAG engine (sparse BM25 + dense ChromaDB with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, k=60), serverless isolated Python code sandbox execution, and bank-grade 256-bit JWT authentication with 16 granular RBAC permissions. GitHub: https://github.com/Sonu-Thomas-001/Multi-Agent-Enterprise-AI-Assistant
- **Versant Practice Test Simulator**: Realistic speaking & listening exam simulator built with React 19, TypeScript, and Google Gemini AI. Features real-time speech recognition, text-to-speech audio delivery, automated GSE & CEFR proficiency scoring (10-90 scale), adaptive timers, word-by-word diff comparisons, and print-ready PDF scorecards across test sections Parts A-F. GitHub: https://github.com/Sonu-Thomas-001/Versant-Practice-Test
- **ResolveAI**: Intelligent IT service desk assistant built as a proof-of-concept with FastAPI, LangGraph (15-node state machine), and ChromaDB vector RAG. Automates incident triage, executes mock diagnostic tools (VPN, email, account, device health), computes confidence scores, and halts for human-in-the-loop approvals before ticket creation on 100% synthetic enterprise data. GitHub: https://github.com/Sonu-Thomas-001/IT-Service-Desk-Agent
